## Summary

Describe what this change does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Non-breaking change (backward compatible)
- [ ] Breaking change (API, behavior, or platform support)
- [ ] Documentation only

## Testing

Commands run and results (from a clean install):

```bash
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm run test
npm run format:check
```

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Build passes
- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Formatting passes

## Checking list

- [ ] No secrets or credentials introduced.
- [ ] Docs (README / docs/) updated to match.
- [ ] Changelog updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] No placeholder or unimplemented APIs added.
